FED.declarationFormText: I declare (or certify, verify, or state) under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on (date).
FED.juratHints: No notary required for 28 U.S.C. § 1746 declarations
FED.notes: FRCP 4(l) requires server's affidavit; 28 U.S.C. § 1746 allows unsworn declaration substitute

CA.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing is true and correct.
CA.juratHints: POS-010 is mandatory Judicial Council form; no notary required
CA.notes: CCP § 2015.5 authorizes unsworn declaration; POS-010 is mandatory form per CRC 2.150

TX.declarationStatute: Tex. R. Civ. P. 107(e); Tex. Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code § 132.001
TX.declarationFormText: My name is ___, I am at least 18 years old, and my address is ___, ___, ___, ___, and ___. I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed in ___ County, State of ___, on the ___ day of ___, ___
TX.juratHints: TRCP 107(e) allows penalty-of-perjury declaration; CPRC § 132.001 confirms UUDA adoption
TX.notes: TRCP 107(g) allows electronic/fax filing; Rule 107 form language must be substantially followed

OK.declarationFormText: I state under penalty of perjury under the laws of Oklahoma that the foregoing is true and correct.
OK.juratHints: 12 O.S. § 2004(G)(2) requires licensed process server affidavit; § 426 allows unsworn substitute
OK.notes: 12 O.S. § 426 excludes certain documents but return of service is not excluded

CO.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury under the law of Colorado that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on the __ day of __, __, at ___ (city or other location, and state or country)
CO.juratHints: CRCP 4(h) allows unsworn declaration; UUDA adopted
CO.notes: JDF 1034 uses Colorado UUDA perjury block; older self-help pages outdated vs CRCP 4(h)

UT.declarationStatute: Utah R. Civ. P. 4(e)(1); Utah Code Tit. 78B, Ch. 18a (UUDA)
UT.declarationFormText: I declare under criminal penalty under the law of Utah that everything stated in this document is true. Signed at ___ (city, and state or country).
UT.juratHints: URCP 4(e)(1) expressly allows unsworn declaration for non-attorney/sheriff/constable/USMS servers
UT.notes: Official proof form 1020GE uses unsworn declaration

NV.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on the __ day of __, ___
NV.juratHints: NRS 53.045 allows unsworn declaration; in-state vs out-of-state wording differs
NV.notes: NRCP 4(d)(1) requires proof by affidavit; NRS 53.045 declaration substantively satisfies

OR.declarationFormText: I hereby declare that the above statement is true to the best of my knowledge and belief, and that I understand it is made for use as evidence in court and is subject to penalty for perjury.
OR.juratHints: ORCP 1 E allows declaration in lieu of any affidavit; Certificate of Service is preferred
OR.notes: ORCP 7 F(2)(a)(i) for non-sheriff certificate; publication proof: affidavit OR declaration per ORCP 7 F(2)(b)

AZ.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.
AZ.juratHints: ARCP 80(c) allows unsworn declaration; registered server must state registration county
AZ.notes: ARCP 4(g)(3) requires non-sheriff return accompanied by affidavit; 80(c) declaration satisfies

WA.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury under the law of the State of Washington that the foregoing is true and correct.
WA.juratHints: Unsworn declaration under RCW 5.50.050 has same effect as affidavit for returns incl. out-of-state service (CR 4(g)(6) oath before notary is an alternative, not a requirement); notarized affidavit also accepted.
WA.notes: RCW 5.50 (UUDA, foreign-declarations version since 2011) applies to returns incl. out-of-state service; declaration under RCW 5.50.050 valid proof. Verified 2026-10-24 against CR 4(c)/4(e)(2)/4(g), CR 5(b), RCW 4.28.180, RCW 5.50.010-.060.

NY.declarationFormText: I affirm this ___ day of ______, ____, under the penalties of perjury under the laws of New York, which may include a fine or imprisonment, that the foregoing is true, and I understand that this document may be filed in an action or proceeding in a court of law.
NY.juratHints: CPLR 2106 affirmation mandatory wording; covers proof of service under CPLR 306(d)
NY.notes: CPLR 306(d) requires affidavit form; 2106 allows affirmation substitute with mandatory block text

PA.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury under the law of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania that the foregoing is true and correct. Signed on (date) at (city/location, state, country)
PA.juratHints: Rule 76 defines affidavit to include unsworn statement subject to 18 Pa.C.S. § 4904; § 6206 provides mandatory form
PA.notes: Pa.R.C.P. 405(d) requires affidavit; Rule 76 + § 4904 allows unsworn verification

IL.declarationFormText: I certify under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.
IL.juratHints: 735 ILCS 5/2-202 requires private return by affidavit; 5/1-109 certification covers return/proof of service
IL.notes: Certification under 1-109 has same force as sworn; no notary required

MI.declarationFormText: I declare under the penalties of perjury that this _________ has been examined by me and that its contents are true to the best of my information, knowledge, and belief.
MI.juratHints: MCR 2.104(A)(3) allows private server written statement verified under 1.109(D)(3)
MI.notes: SCAO memo 2023-03-28: declaration under penalty of perjury; notarization removed from forms

MN.declarationStatute: Minn. Gen. R. Prac. 15; Minn. Stat. § 358.116
MN.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.
MN.juratHints: Minn. R. Civ. P. 4.06 allows affidavit; Gen. R. Prac. 15 + § 358.116 allows penalty-of-perjury documents as affidavits
MN.notes: Must state time, place, manner; penalty-of-perjury signature built for e-file

KS.declarationFormText: I declare (or verify, certify or state) under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on (date).
KS.juratHints: 60-312(a)(2) allows non-officer affidavit OR declaration per 53-601; 14-day return filing deadline
KS.notes: Judicial Council Return of Service form has both jurat and 53-601 declaration blocks

IA.declarationStatute: Iowa Code § 622.1; Iowa R. Civ. P. 1.308
IA.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on (date).
IA.juratHints: Rule 1.308(1) requires non-officer proof by affidavit; § 622.1 unsworn certification reaches proofs of service
IA.notes: Proof filed by served party's 20-day response window; 90-day service window; Form 1 has NO return section

HI.declarationFormText: I DECLARE UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY UNDER THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF HAWAII that the foregoing is true and correct.
HI.juratHints: Court-level dependent: Circuit form 1C-P-022 uses jurat; District form 1DC47 uses unsworn declaration
HI.notes: Engine must pick execution block by COURT LEVEL (circuit jurat vs district unsworn)

VT.declarationFormText: I declare that the above statement is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that if the above statement is false, I will be subject to the penalty of perjury or to other sanctions in the discretion of the court.
VT.juratHints: Rule 43(h) applies to ANY affidavit/oath required by the rules with no exceptions; reaches 4(i) non-officer returns
VT.notes: Indifferent-person appointment still required (4(c) + 12 V.S.A. § 731); 60-day service window

ND.declarationFormText: I declare, under penalty of perjury under the law of North Dakota, that the foregoing is true and correct. Signed on [date] at [city, state/country]
ND.juratHints: Rule 4(i) as amended eff. 3/1/2021: private server proof = declaration under penalty of perjury; word 'affidavit' eliminated
ND.notes: Chapter 31-15 applies to declarants in the U.S.; proof files WITH initiating pleading

SD.declarationFormText: I declare under penalty of perjury under the law of South Dakota that the foregoing is true and correct. Signed on [date] at [city/location, state]
SD.juratHints: SDCL § 18-7-6 (SL 2018) provides UUDA-style declaration; applies with 15-6-4(g) non-officer affidavit requirement

WY.declarationFormText: I certify under penalty of false swearing that the foregoing is true.
WY.juratHints: Wyoming-specific phrase: 'penalty of false swearing' not 'penalty of perjury'; § 1-2-104 certification satisfies without notary
WY.notes: Engine must use the § 1-2-104 phrase exactly; false certification = false swearing under § 6-5-303(c)

MD.declarationFormText: I solemnly affirm under the penalties of perjury that the contents of the foregoing paper are true to the best of my knowledge, information, and belief.
MD.juratHints: Rule 2-126(a)/3-126(a): proof filed promptly; non-sheriff affidavit adds age 18+ recital
MD.notes: Rule 1-304: any required affidavit satisfied by affirmation; NO 72-hour rule (vendor marketing conflation)

FL.juratHints: Fla. Stat. § 48.21 requires signed return-of-service form; e-signature expressly OK; NOT § 92.525 declaration
FL.notes: TRAP: Do NOT auto-pick § 92.525 'declaration of service' for ordinary process. Generate § 48.21 return-of-service. Affidavit only if specific rule/order requires verification.

GA.juratHints: O.C.G.A. § 9-11-4(h) requires signed entry of service; notarized affidavit is accepted instrument; 5 business day filing deadline or answer clock tolls
GA.notes: Proof filed within 5 business days of service date; late filing tolls defendant's answer clock

VA.juratHints: § 8.01-325(B)(2): private server affidavit of qualifications + date/manner of service + name served; stamp/annotation required
VA.notes: 72-hour return window; private-server status + server name/address/telephone must be annotated on return

NC.juratHints: N.C. R. Civ. P. 4(j2)(1) points to G.S. 1-75.10 for default judgments; non-officer affidavit recitals: place/time/manner + qualifications + knew person served
NC.notes: No statewide registration; G.S. 1-75.10(a)(1)b requires knowing the person served to be the defendant

SC.juratHints: SCRCP 4(g): non-sheriff shall make affidavit; S.C. Code §15-10-220 allows swear OR affirm but form mandates notarization
SC.notes: Form 4-206 return historically shows oath/notary block; safer practice: notarized affidavit

NJ.juratHints: R. 4:4-7: proof by affidavit; AOC form CN 10516 carries BOTH jurat AND penalty-of-perjury blocks; jurat is primary
NJ.notes: R. 1:4-4(b) certification alternative exists but jurat-form default safest; non-sheriff: facts of diligent inquiry required

MA.juratHints: Mass. R. Civ. P. 4(f): non-sheriff/constable shall make affidavit; special appointment required for private servers
MA.notes: No statewide private 'affidavit of service' for routine personal service; clerk/mail return receipts often control

OH.juratHints: Civ.R. 4.1(B)(2)(a): court-designated server endorses service on the process and returns to clerk; no affidavit or declaration needed
OH.notes: OVERTURN: Ohio uses endorsement model, not affidavit/declaration for personal/residence service

AL.juratHints: Ala. R. Civ. P. 4(i)(1)(C): private server (19+, non-party, not related within 3rd degree) endorses service on process; return indicates name/address/phone
AL.notes: OVERTURN: Alabama uses endorsement model like Ohio; Form C-34 uses 'I certify...' with NO jurat and NO perjury block; 60-day unserved return window

AR.juratHints: Ark. R. Civ. P. 4: non-sheriff certificate must be sworn; official form has dedicated jurat
AR.notes: Non-sheriff certificate must be sworn per ARCP 4

CT.juratHints: Civil process traditionally via state marshals; private nationwide affidavit often wrong vehicle
CT.notes: Indifferent person service is limited by statute/practice; treat as affidavit-required

DE.juratHints: Super. R. 4(g): private server return shall be verified (sworn); Chancery R. 4(i): service must be proven by affidavit; 10 Del. C. § 3927 = opt-in by court rule; no rule opts in for ROS
DE.notes: 10 Del. C. § 53A is foreign-declarant-only; Chancery requires registration with Register

LA.juratHints: CCP art. 1292: sheriff's return is the statutory model; private-server original-process path is narrow
LA.notes: Private-server path depends on authorization; nationwide private affidavit often wrong vehicle

MS.juratHints: MRCP 4(f): non-sheriff shall make affidavit thereof; whole official rules PDF grep = zero 'unsworn'
MS.notes: No unsworn substitute confirmed for returns of service

MO.juratHints: § 506.180.2: private server shall make affidavit as to time, place and manner; out-of-state oath before any empowered officer
MO.notes: Rule 54.20 cite unverified - use § 506.180 statute instead

MT.juratHints: Rule 4(r)(1)(B): non-officer that person's affidavit; MT adopted UUFDA (26-1-1103) - foreign-declarant-only, NOT generic UUDA
MT.notes: Affidavit states: time, date, place, manner of service + server of legal age + knew the person served; UUFDA = foreign only

NE.juratHints: Official CC 3:21 form; private path swear/affirm + notary acknowledgment; § 25-507.01 requires signed proof but NO oath/affidavit language
NE.notes: UUDA status unverified; stay affidavit-only until confirmed; Neb. Rev. Stat. § 25-507.01 content requirements

DC.juratHints: Super. Ct. Civ. R. 4(l)(1): Affidavit Required; proof must be by server's affidavit under oath; per-defendant affidavit; physical description facts
DC.notes: Special Process Server affidavit; often CV-3035 family; marshal-only exemption

AK.juratHints: Civ. R. 4(f): non-peace-officer shall make affidavit; proof sets forth manner, place, date of service, and all pleadings served
AK.notes: Licensed process servers; form family varies by process type

NH.juratHints: RSA 509:3: writs directed to sheriff only; private person serves only as sheriff-appointed special deputy; RSA 510:2-a: service details endorsed ON THE WRIT
NH.notes: Out-of-state/nonresident path requires JP/notary signature; return filed within 21 days of court-set service deadline

RI.juratHints: Rule 4(j): non-officer private server shall make affidavit thereof; officers sign unsworn official return on SC-CMS-1 summons
RI.notes: UUDA bill introduced but NOT enacted; 120 days to serve; proof returned forthwith

ME.juratHints: M.R.Civ.P. 4(h): non-officer (court appointee under 4(c)(2) or out-of-state under 4(e)) shall make proof by affidavit; officer return unsworn on CV-038
ME.notes: Appointment-based private serving; 4(e) out-of-state affidavit = time/manner/place; deadlines: file within 20-day response or 90 days from commencement

TN.juratHints: Tenn. R. Civ. P. 4.03 requires prompt proof; summons packaging court-driven
TN.notes: Uncertain if declaration accepted; stay affidavit-only until primary confirmation

NM.juratHints: Rule 1-004(L): non-sheriff proof by affidavit; Form 4-206 return mandates notarized signature; Rule 1-011(B) affirmation exists but form requires notary
NM.notes: Form 4-206 fields: qualification recital (18+, not a party), 7 service-method checkboxes, fees, signature/title, sheriff-exempt jurat

KY.juratHints: CR 4.03 return; out-of-state personal service proof by affidavit CR 4.04(8); in-state return less explicit
KY.notes: Conditional; stay affidavit-only until primary confirmation for in-state private returns

IN.juratHints: Trial Rule 4; no mandatory PDF found; content rules still control
IN.notes: Uncertain; stay fail-closed until primary confirmation

ID.juratHints: CAO Cv 2-4X Affidavit of Service is statewide court-assistance form commonly expected
ID.notes: Unsworn practice/UUDA-like uncertain; prefer CAO form; stay fail-closed

WV.juratHints: Family form SCA-FC-132 exists; civil less standardized; affidavit practice common
WV.notes: Secondary sources report declaration OK but not primary-verified; stay fail-closed

WI.juratHints: Routine proof = plain unsworn proof of service (§801.10(3), form-free, failure harmless); affidavit required ONLY upon challenge (§801.10(4)(a))
WI.notes: Keep affidavit-only (conservative) for v1; document the challenge rule; §906.06(2m) substitute question OPEN

AL.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, depose and state that I am at least eighteen (18) years of age, not a party to the above-entitled action, and not related within the third degree by blood or marriage to the party instituting this action (Ala. R. Civ. P. 4(i)(1)(B)).

AK.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, depose and state that I am a person authorized to serve civil process in the State of Alaska — a Civilian Process Server licensed by the Alaska Department of Public Safety under 13 AAC 67 (License No. {{licenseNumber}}) or specially appointed by the Court — over the age of eighteen (18) years, and not a party to this action.

AR.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, depose and state that I am at least eighteen (18) years of age, not a party to this action, and duly appointed to serve civil process by Administrative Order No. 20 of the Circuit Court pursuant to Ark. R. Civ. P. 4(c)(2).
requiredBodyClauses: cameToHandDate

AZ.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, state that I am a Certified Private Process Server registered in {{registrationCounty}} County, State of Arizona (Registration No. {{licenseNumber}}), not a party to this action, and not less than twenty-one (21) years of age (Ariz. R. Civ. P. 4(d); ACJA § 7-204).
requiredBodyClauses: cameToHandDateTime
serviceFeeBreakdown

CA.qualificationText: At the time of service I was at least 18 years of age and not a party to this action. I am a Registered California Process Server (Registration No. {{licenseNumber}}) or exempt from registration under Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 22350(b). My address and telephone number are stated below, and my fee for service was as recorded by the firm.
requiredBodyClauses: serviceFeeBreakdown

CO.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, declare that I am eighteen (18) years of age or older and not a party to this action (C.R.C.P. 4(d)).

CT.qualificationText: STATE OF CONNECTICUT, SS: Then and there, by virtue hereof and by direction of the Plaintiff's attorney, I, {{serverName}}, a duly authorized State Marshal, Constable, or Indifferent Person under Conn. Gen. Stat. § 52-50, or a person authorized by law to serve process in the jurisdiction of service under Conn. Gen. Stat. § 52-57a, made due and legal service upon the recipient by leaving a true and attested copy of the original process, with my doings thereon endorsed.
requiredBodyClauses: The within and foregoing is the original process with my doings hereon endorsed.
FEES: itemized per Conn. Gen. Stat. § 52-261.
CT.qualificationTextUnserved: I, {{serverName}}, a duly authorized State Marshal, Constable, or Indifferent Person under Conn. Gen. Stat. § 52-50, or a person authorized by law to serve process in the jurisdiction of service under Conn. Gen. Stat. § 52-57a, over the age of eighteen (18) years and not a party to this action, received the original process for service by direction of the Plaintiff's attorney and have made due and diligent efforts to effect service, as more fully appears by my doings hereon endorsed.

DC.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, declare that I am at least eighteen (18) years of age and not a party to the above-entitled action (D.C. Super. Ct. R. Civ. P. 4(c)(2)). My residence or business address and telephone number are stated below.
requiredBodyClauses: physicalDescriptionOfRecipient

DE.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly verified, state that I am at least eighteen (18) years of age, not a party to this action, and a Special Process Server duly appointed and registered with the Court pursuant to Del. Super. Ct. Civ. R. 4(d).

FED.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, declare that I am at least 18 years old and not a party to this action (Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(c)(2)). My server's address is stated below.
requiredBodyClauses: cameToHandDate

FL.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years, not a party to nor interested in the above-styled action, and am a Certified Process Server (CPS #{{licenseNumber}}) or Special Process Server duly appointed in the circuit or county where service was made pursuant to Fla. Stat. §§ 48.021 / 48.27. This process came to hand on the date and at the time stated above (Fla. Stat. § 48.21(1)). I placed the date and time of service and my identification number and initials on the first page of the copy served (Fla. Stat. § 48.031(5)).
requiredBodyClauses: This process came to hand on the date and at the time stated above (Fla. Stat. § 48.21(1)).
I placed the date and time of service and my identification number and initials on the first page of the copy served (Fla. Stat. § 48.031(5)).
FL.qualificationTextUnserved: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years, not a party to nor interested in the above-styled action, and am a Certified Process Server (CPS #{{licenseNumber}}) or Special Process Server duly appointed in the circuit or county where service was attempted pursuant to Fla. Stat. §§ 48.021 / 48.27. This process came to hand on the date and at the time stated above (Fla. Stat. § 48.21(1)).

GA.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, depose and state that I am a Citizen of the United States, at least eighteen (18) years of age, not a party to this action, not related to or employed by any party or attorney herein, and am a Certified Process Server pursuant to O.C.G.A. § 9-11-4.1 (Cert. No. {{licenseNumber}}) AND/OR permanently or specially appointed by the Court pursuant to O.C.G.A. § 9-11-4(c).
requiredBodyClauses: cameToHandDate

HI.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years, not a party to this action, and an Independent Civil Process Server registered with the Hawaii Department of Law Enforcement pursuant to HRS Chapter 634D (Reg. No. {{licenseNumber}}).
requiredBodyClauses: Service was NOT made between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. on premises not open to the public without written approval of a judge (Haw. R. Civ. P. 4(b)(11)).

IA.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, certify that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years and am neither a party to this action nor the attorney for a party to this action (Iowa R. Civ. P. 1.302(4)).

ID.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years and not a party to the above-entitled action (I.R.C.P. 4(c)(1)).

IL.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of 18 years, not a party to this action, and a Registered Employee of a licensed Private Detective Agency under 225 ILCS 447 (and, for Cook County service, duly registered under the Cook County Sheriff's Order of Registration), or a person appointed by the court under 735 ILCS 5/2-202.
requiredBodyClauses: Physical description of person served: Sex: {{recipientSex}}, Race: {{recipientRace}}, Approx. Age: {{recipientAge}} (735 ILCS 5/2-203(b)).

IN.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years and not a party to this action (Ind. R. Trial P. 4.12 / 4.15).

KS.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years, not a party to this action, and duly appointed/authorized to serve process pursuant to K.S.A. 60-303(d)(3).
requiredBodyClauses: Notice: This return of service must be filed with the court promptly and in any event no later than 14 days after service (K.S.A. 60-312(d)).

KY.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, depose and state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years, not a party to this action, and for in-state service a Special Bailiff duly appointed under Ky. R. Civ. P. 4.01(1), or a person authorized by the law of the place where service is made for out-of-state service under Ky. R. Civ. P. 4.04.

LA.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, being duly sworn, depose and state that I am of the age of majority, not a party to this action, and duly appointed by Order of the Court dated {{appointmentOrderDate}} pursuant to La. C.C.P. art. 1293, or authorized for out-of-state service pursuant to La. R.S. 13:3204.

MA.qualificationText: I, {{serverName}}, state that I am over the age of eighteen (18) years, not a party to this action, and a Constable / Special Process Server duly appointed by the Court pursuant to Mass. R. Civ. P. 4(c).
requiredBodyClauses: If served at last and usual place of abode: I further certify that I mailed a copy of the process via first-class mail, postage prepaid, to the Defendant at said last and usual place of abode (G.L. c. 223, § 31).
